plan.title: Forward auction auto title for product and location

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type to Auction and configure the required auction settings.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Confirm that an auction template was applied before adding the product.
Add the specified product as the single line item.
Choose Plant Name for the product's delivery location, which should trigger the automatic title.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Forward Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Assert that the untouched title field contains the expected product-and-location auto title.
